# Prices of the workshop

The workshop publishes its prices once a year and keeps a copy in the window, beside the door.

1. A full service of the bicycle costs 950 pesos and takes one working day, the parts included.
2. A change of the inner tube costs 180 pesos and takes half an hour while the customer waits.
3. A pair of brake pads costs 240 pesos and is fitted the same morning the bicycle arrives.
4. A new chain with its cassette costs 780 pesos and is fitted with the next service.
5. The adjustment of the gears costs 150 pesos and takes twenty minutes on the stand.
6. The wheel of a bicycle is trued for 200 pesos and left ready the next day.
7. A basket, a lamp or a bell is fitted for 90 pesos each, and the part is charged apart.
8. The workshop stores a bicycle for a week for 120 pesos while the customer travels.
9. A bicycle that stays more than a month pays the storage of every week it stays.
10. A custom build starts at 18000 pesos and the workshop quotes it in person, never by telephone.
11. The prices are in pesos and include the tax of the workshop.
